items.reason: A gentle peptide cream suits your goal of smoother-looking lines and a firmer-looking feel, and adds comfort to skin that scans as low in moisture.
A mild 0.3% retinol is a sensible starting strength for visibly softening the look of lines and uneven texture.
Retinol makes skin more sun-sensitive, so a mineral SPF 50 each morning is needed to go with it and helps protect your results.

response.routine_note: In the morning, cleanse gently and finish with the SPF; at night, use the retinol two nights a week, build up slowly as skin feels comfortable, and follow with the peptide cream. Everything else in your cart is fine to keep as it is, and I added only the sunscreen to keep the routine short and easy to follow.
